en: Changed the card for approving a subagent's plan to two choices, "Yes, and switch to default (ask each time) for this session" and "No", chosen with the arrow keys and Enter (typed text moves to No)
zh: 批准 subagent 计划的卡片改为两个选项，"Yes, and switch to default (ask each time) for this session" 和 "No"，用方向键和 Enter 选择（输入文字会移到 No）
